Name: Better woods
Author: galigeigei
Description:
[center][size=6][b][i][b][size=6]-[/size][size=6]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size][/b]
[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#e69138]This mod will expand the woods map of the original game！
这个Mod将在原版的基础上拓展森林地图！[/color][/font]
[b][size=6]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size][/b][/i][/b][/size][/center][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/3995/3995-1559038321-963300700.png[/img]

[b][size=5]1.There will be[/size] [color=#b45f06][size=6][u]More Hard wood[/u][/size][/color] [size=5]on this map.[/size]
[/b][b][size=5]  [/size][size=5] 将会刷新[/size][color=#b45f06][size=6]更多的硬木[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#6aa84f][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/3995/3995-1562054835-832979423.png[/img][/color]

[b][size=5]2.You can[/size] [color=#00ffff][size=6]Swim[/size][/color] [size=5]on the map,and it can restore physical strength.[/size]
[/b]    [b][size=5]你可以在水潭里[/size][color=#00ffff][size=6]游泳[/size][/color][size=5]，恢复体力[/size][/b]
[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/3995/3995-1559038941-226842669.png[/img]﻿

[b][size=5]3.You can [/size][color=#ff7700][size=6][u]Sleep[/u][/size][/color][size=5] in a tent,and save the and it can save the game.
[/size][/b][color=#6aa84f]    [/color][b][size=5]你可以直接在帐篷里[/size][color=#ff7700][size=6]睡觉[/size][/color][size=5]，保存游戏[/size][/b]
[size=5][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/3995/3995-1559038917-239186339.png[/img][/size]

[b][size=5]4.Add a new [/size][color=#6d9eeb][size=6]Temple Store[/size][/color][color=#6aa84f][size=5].
[/size][/color][/b]  [color=#6aa84f]  [/color][b][size=5]添加了一个小的[/size][color=#6d9eeb][size=6]寺庙商店[/size][/color][/b]
[b][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/3995/3995-1562053033-978697035.png[/img]
[color=#ffff00][size=6]Path description：[/size]
[size=5]地图路径总览[/size][/color]
[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/3995/3995-1562054651-432952713.png[/img]

[size=6][color=#ff0000]Installation method:
[/color][/size][size=5]First install[color=#ff0000]（Necessary）[/color]
1. Content Patcher（ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]）
2. Entoarox Framework（[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269[/url]）
3.Advanced Location Loader（[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2270]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2270[/url]）
[/size][/b][size=5][b]
4.Drag [color=#ffff00]Better Woods[/color] and [color=#ffff00]Temple Shop 2.0[/color] folders into the MODS folder
5.Open the game in [/b][/size][size=5][b][u]SMAPI console Enter[/u] ‘’[color=#ffff00]world_bushreset[/color]‘’，Keep it for one day
[/b][/size][size=5][b]6.And Enjoy![/b][/size]

Downloads.Description:
This is a compatible patch that will be compatible with the delivery of Immersive Farm 2 mod，
WoodsZ.tbin file under compressed package，Replace with Stardew Valley>Mods>Better Woods>assets
Then enter it in the SMAPI console “world_bushreset”
